## Before you start {.study}

- **What you need:** a computer (or a tablet) with a browser and a Google
  account (Google Sites at `sites.google.com`), the link of your form from
  Online activity 9, and your phone to check the site.
- **Time:** about 50 minutes. Work alone, at your own speed.
- **How it works:** read Steps 1–3 and answer their questions: the page
  checks each answer at once. Then do the **Tasks to submit**.
- **Your project:** the service that you chose in Online activity 9 (A, B,
  C or D). All the text of its site is given below: you only copy it.
- **What you submit:** the web address of your site and one screenshot, on
  the university e-learning platform, before lecture 10.

{{< glossary website website-builder site-navigation mobile-view publish-site >}}

## Step 1 · Three pages with the given text {.study}

- **Blank site** (+), then the site name: the name of your service.
- **Pages › +** for the pages **Service** and **Contact**; the menu shows
  them by itself.
- **Themes:** choose one theme. **Insert › Images › Search** for one free
  picture on the Home page.

| | Home | Service | Contact |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A** Study Room | Book the quiet study room of the library. | One hour · up to 6 students · Sunday to Thursday | Library, first floor · Sunday to Thursday, 8:00 to 16:00 |
| **B** Easy Print | Print your notes, reports and posters. | 5 pages for 0.25 JD · ready the next day | Building B, ground floor · Sunday to Thursday, 9:00 to 15:00 |
| **C** Fix It | We repair phone screens and batteries. | A new screen from 20 JD · a battery from 10 JD | Shop 4, Main Street · Saturday to Thursday, 10:00 to 18:00 |
| **D** Green Bites | Healthy lunch boxes for the college. | Chicken, falafel or salad · 2 JD a box | The canteen · Sunday to Thursday, 11:00 to 14:00 |

: The text of the three pages of each project service (made up).

::: {.callout-note title="Model · The website of the college gym"}
The college gym has a booking form (Online activity 9). Its site *College
Gym* has three pages: Home (*Welcome to the College Gym!*), Booking (the
times and the button) and Contact. The screen below shows the pages and
the menu.
:::

## Step 2 · A button to your form {.study}

- The customer orders or books with your form (Online activity 9).
- On the **Service** page: **Insert › Button**. Name: **Book now** (or
  **Order now**). Link: paste the link of your form.
- In the preview, click the button: your form opens.

::: {.callout-note title="Model · Book now"}
On the Booking page of the gym site: **Insert › Button**, the name *Book
now*, and the link of the gym form. A visitor taps it, and the booking
form opens.
:::

**In a browser, on a computer.** The orange numbers show where to click.

::: {.screens}
![[1]{.step-n} Click **Insert › Button**. [2]{.step-n} Type the name. [3]{.step-n} Paste the link of your form. [4]{.step-n} Click **Insert**.](images/sites-button-1.png)
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · The button"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="the Contact page|a picture"}
Which link goes into the button Book now?
:   the link of your form

    Why: The button opens the form, so the customer can book.

On which page do you put the button?
:   the Service page

    Why: The customer sees the service and then books.
:::
:::

## Step 3 · Publish and check on a phone {.study}

- First **Preview** (the eye) and the phone: is it easy to read?
- **Publish:** type the web address (the name of your service, no spaces),
  then **Publish**.
- Open the address on your phone, and tap the menu (≡) and the button.

::: {.callout-note title="Model · The gym site online"}
The gym site is published at *sites.google.com/view/college-gym*. On a
phone the menu is the ≡ button, and *Book now* opens the form.
:::

**In a browser, on a computer.** The orange numbers show where to click.

::: {.screens}
![[1]{.step-n} Click **Publish**. [2]{.step-n} Type the web address. [3]{.step-n} Click **Publish**.](images/sites-publish-1.png)
:::

{{< sim file="sims/design-check.html" poster="sims/design-check.png" title="Design Check: fix the page" height="640" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Publish"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="send the file by e-mail|print it"}
How do customers open your site?
:   with its web address

    Why: Publishing puts the site on the Internet with an address.

Where do you check the phone view before you publish?
:   Preview, then the phone

    Why: The preview shows the small screen of a phone.
:::
:::

## Tasks to submit {.tasks}

### Task 1 · The three pages

In Google Sites, make the site of your service: the site name, the three
pages with the given text of the table (Step 1), one theme and one
picture. (Step 1 shows how.)

### Task 2 · The button to your form

On the Service page, insert the button **Book now** or **Order now** with
the link of your form. (Step 2 shows how.)

### Task 3 · Publish

Publish the site and open it on your phone. (Step 3 shows how.)

a) Paste the web address of your site here.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

*Submit:* the web address and a screenshot of your site on your phone.

## How to submit

Upload the web address and the screenshot, **before lecture 10**.
